title: A Devil in the Pocket
description: The devil dances in empty pockets. From the ever reliable Miyu Distribution comes this dark fairy tale of secrecy and greed. After witnessing a violent crime, seven children are drawn into a pact of silence, where they discover it becomes impossible to return to their innocent world.
producers: MoÏra Marguin In a deserted future Kolkata
a refugee family is barely surviving
after cataclysmic floods deluge the city. As they move through the streets in search of food
they have a terrifying encounter with a tiger. Wade is a sinuous and prescient animation about the beautiful and brutal forces of nature.
